source=next((base/'elmerfem').glob('elmerfem-*')); cmake=next((base/'cmake').glob('cmake-*'))/'CMake.app/Contents/bin/cmake'; build=base/'build'; prefix=base/'prefix'
env=os.environ.copy()
for k in ('OMP_NUM_THREADS','OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS','MKL_NUM_THREADS','VECLIB_MAXIMUM_THREADS','BLIS_NUM_THREADS','NUMEXPR_NUM_THREADS','CMAKE_BUILD_PARALLEL_LEVEL'):env[k]='1'
env['XDG_CACHE_HOME']=str(root/'.cache'); env['CLANG_MODULE_CACHE_PATH']=str(base/'clang-cache');env['TMPDIR']=str(base/'tmp');Path(env['TMPDIR']).mkdir(exist_ok=True)
flags=['-DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release','-DCMAKE_C_COMPILER=/usr/bin/clang','-DCMAKE_CXX_COMPILER=/usr/bin/clang++','-DCMAKE_Fortran_COMPILER=/opt/homebrew/bin/gfortran','-DCMAKE_INSTALL_PREFIX='+str(prefix),'-DCMAKE_INTERPROCEDURAL_OPTIMIZATION=OFF','-DCMAKE_C_FLAGS_RELEASE=-O1 -DNDEBUG','-DCMAKE_CXX_FLAGS_RELEASE=-O1 -DNDEBUG','-DCMAKE_Fortran_FLAGS_RELEASE=-O1 -DNDEBUG','-DUSE_MACOS_PACKAGE_MANAGER=OFF','-DWITH_MPI=OFF','-DWITH_OpenMP=OFF','-DWITH_ELMERGUI=OFF','-DWITH_ELMERPOST=OFF','-DWITH_ElmerIce=OFF','-DWITH_XIOS=OFF','-DWITH_NETCDF=OFF','-DWITH_Mumps=OFF','-DWITH_Hypre=OFF','-DWITH_CHOLMOD=OFF','-DWITH_Trilinos=OFF','-DWITH_FETI4I=OFF','-DWITH_CONTRIB=OFF','-DWITH_LUA=OFF','-DWITH_MMG=OFF','-DWITH_PARMMG=OFF','-DWITH_ROCALUTION=OFF','-DWITH_Zoltan=OFF','-DBUILD_TESTING=OFF','-DBLA_VENDOR=Apple','-DINCLUDE_ELMER_MODULES=HeatSolve;FluxSolver;ResultOutputSolve;SaveData']
commands=[('cmake-version',[str(cmake),'--version']),('configure',[str(cmake),'-S',str(source),'-B',str(build),*flags]),('build',[str(cmake),'--build',str(build),'--parallel','1']),('install',[str(cmake),'--install',str(build)])]
record={'status':'running','setup_total_wall_cap_s':600,'owner_acquisition_wall_s':start['download_wall_s'],'local_started_unix':start['local_started_unix'],'one_build_job':True,'thread_env':{k:env[k] for k in env if k.endswith('NUM_THREADS') or k in ('VECLIB_MAXIMUM_THREADS','CMAKE_BUILD_PARALLEL_LEVEL')},'source_commit':'a19504ac53ec222e3355e182b08f2ff280c2203a','source_archive_sha256':'1451e82f05b9661d82e1ebbf6e90ac373fc1b19482eef3889334a6df5ff0144a','cmake_archive_sha256':'d1449f969c54d5c00886d5b643340d493dfb3c81cb39ee29b35453395c11ebf7','steps':[],'solver_qualified':False,'actual_baffle_attempted':False}
try:
 for name,cmd in commands:
  remaining=deadline-time.time()
  if remaining<=0:raise TimeoutError('Inclusive setup cap reached before '+name)
  before=resource.getrusage(resource.RUSAGE_CHILDREN);t=time.time(); step={'name':name,'command':cmd,'budget_remaining_wall_s':remaining};record['steps'].append(step)
  (base/'setup-record.json').write_text(json.dumps(record,indent=2)+'\n')

   proc=subprocess.Popen(cmd,stdout=log,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT,env=env,start_new_session=True)
   try:code=proc.wait(timeout=remaining)
   except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
    os.killpg(proc.pid,signal.SIGKILL);proc.wait();raise TimeoutError('Inclusive setup cap reached during '+name)
  after=resource.getrusage(resource.RUSAGE_CHILDREN);step.update(returncode=code,wall_s=time.time()-t,child_cpu_s=(after.ru_utime+after.ru_stime)-(before.ru_utime+before.ru_stime),cumulative_peak_child_rss_bytes_macos=after.ru_maxrss,log_sha256=hashlib.sha256((base/(name+'.log')).read_bytes()).hexdigest())
  print(name,code,round(step['wall_s'],3),flush=True)
  if code!=0:raise RuntimeError(name+' failed; no automatic retry')
 record['status']='installed_isolated_not_qualified'
